old-king-s-highway.title: Old King's Highway
old-king-s-highway.slogan: Route 6A along the bay side of the Cape: village greens, salt marsh and old captains’ houses, and the only road on the Cape that was never widened.

old-king-s-highway.story: 55 km from Sandwich to Orleans, about 1 h 03 of riding. It goes by way of West Barnstable, Yarmouth Port, Dennis and Brewster. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
